title: GPTcrafter
description: This resource pack was fully retextured using ChatGPT.The concept is simple: Minecraft texture is regenerated, redesigned, and recreated with a consistent style while keeping the original Minecraft vibe.
body:
GPT Crafter is the result of many hours of creativity, experimentation, and iteration.
This project exists thanks to players like you who enjoy discovering new visuals and fresh designs for Minecraft.
If you want to show your appreciation and support the continued development of the pack, you are welcome to buy me a coffee.


---

🧱 GPT Crafter Overview

GPT Crafter is a resource pack that brings a new twist to Minecraft by introducing AI-assisted textures created with ChatGPT.
Every week, the pack receives an update adding 7 newly retextured blocks, giving the game a fresh and evolving visual identity.

Unlike other resource packs that change the entire look of the game, GPT Crafter keeps Minecraft’s classic charm intact.
The goal is not to replace Minecraft’s style, but to gently enhance it with unique, creative, and fun textures.


---

🎨 Why Use GPT Crafter?

✔ 7 new block textures added every week

✔ Unique designs crafted with the help of AI

✔ Compatible with most Minecraft versions

✔ Lightweight, simple, and easy to install

✔ Continually expanding — the pack grows over time

✔ Keeps the game recognizable while adding fresh visual variety


GPT Crafter aims to give you that classic Minecraft feel, but with subtle surprises waiting every time you explore
